chapter: Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!
act_title: Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!

quests.title: Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!

dialogue.t: You must be the world-famous {NICKNAME}! And this must be the Traveler's best companion, Paimon!
Wow! How did you know our names?
You are the island's most distinguished guests, of course I know who you are! After all, I am...
I am the world-famous Head of Twilight Theater!

dialogue.sit: I can't believe someone would call himself world-famous.

dialogue.t: You say you're world-famous, but we've never heard of you.
After a painstaking amount of work, our play, "Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess," is finally ready for the stage!
There are five acts in this play, each with two scenes...
My distinguished guests, you have come at the perfect time! The show is about to start! Please take a seat!
I still need to take care of something backstage. Please excuse me.
You are about to witness the debut of Twilight Theater's best ever play! Please sit back and enjoy!

quests.description: The great Prinzessin’s loyal subjects are pleased to perform for you, our guests, a performance most special: a tale of love and valor…
